{{Quote|The Chancellor has given me a very important mission. The Separatists have gathered in the Mustafar system. I'm going there to end this war. Wait for me until I return&hellip; things will be different, I promise.|Darth Vader to his wife Padmé Amidala|<ref name="RotS" />}}
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] and [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], sent his new apprentice, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] on a '''mission''' to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the remaining members of the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] on the [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. The Council, consisting of the surviving top members of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], was a loose end in Sidious' plot to gain control of the Republic and mold it into [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] first [[Galactic Empire/Legends|empire]]. Vader willfully carried out the slaughter after he trapped the council in the [[Separatist Council war room/Legends|War Room]] and [[Separatist Council Conference Room/Legends|Conference Room]], where he slew each Separatist leader, one by one. The slaughter ended with the death of [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]], the [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], who was one of the most influential members of the Council.

As the bloodshed came to an end, [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader contacted Sidious to inform him that the Separatist Council had been killed. Sidious then ordered Vader to send a message to the ships of the Trade Federation which stated all [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] were to be immediately shut down, an order that he carried out, ending the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|The plan has gone as you had promised, my Lord.''"<br />"''You have done well, Viceroy. When my new apprentice, Darth Vader, arrives, he will take care of you.|Nute Gunray And Darth Sidious|<ref name="RotS" />}}
[[File:SepCouncilUtapau-ROTS.png|thumb|left|200px|The Separatist Council on Utapau.]]
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], with [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], having been covertly betrayed by Sidious and killed by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] became the new public head of the Confederacy of Independent Systems. He was ordered by the Sith Lord Darth Sidious to move the Separatist Council, who were on [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]] at the time, to the [[Klegger Corp Mining Facility/Legends|Klegger Corp Mining Facility]] on Mustafar, where he secretly planned to betray and kill them, as they were no longer useful to him. Grievous did so, informing the council of where he was sending them before they boarded a ship to take them there. Immediately afterwards, the [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|Battle of Utapau]] broke out, in which Grievous was killed by Jedi [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], leaving the Separatist Council as the sole public leaders of the Separatists.<ref name="RotS" /> On Mustafar, they were contacted by Darth Sidious, who ordered them to begin shutting down their droid armies.<ref name="RotSn" />

[[File:Sep_council_sidious.png|thumb|right|250px|The Separatist Council meeting with Darth Sidious.]]
When Skywalker betrayed the Jedi, turned to the dark side and pledged himself to Darth Sidious, [[Showdown on Coruscant|becoming Darth Vader]], he was sent to Mustafar after carrying out [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Operation: Knightfall]] to kill the Separatist Council. As Vader approached the facility &mdash; remotely deactivating the air defenses in the process &mdash; the Separatists and their aides had gathered in its war room, where they were guarded by soldiers of the [[Neimoidian Gunnery Battalion]] and [[OOM-series security droid/Legends|OOM security battle droids]]. Sidious contacted the council again and asked if the droids armies had completed shut down, to which Trade Federation Viceroy Nute Gunray confirmed that they had an hour prior. Sidious then deceived the council by telling them that they were to be rewarded for their role in the Clone Wars and that his new apprentice was coming to do so.<ref name="RotSn" /> Gunray and the council, however, were unaware they were being betrayed and discarded by Sidious.

Upon landing, Vader ordered his [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] to stay with [[Darth Vader's green Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|his starfighter]] as he made his way into the facility. He was witnessed by two nearby [[Mustafarian/Legends|Mustafarian]]s. As Vader was lead to the council by [[MSE-series|Mouse droids]], the Separatists stood around talking and viewing the movements of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] on [[Hologram/Legends|holograms]].<ref name="RotS" />

==The assassinations==
{{Quote|Welcome, Lord Vader. We've been expecting you.|[[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation Viceroy]] Nute Gunray|<ref name="RotS" />}}
When Vader entered the war room, the Separatists scrambled to greet him,<ref name="RotSn" /> with Gunray<ref name="RotS" /> and [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] [[San Hill/Legends|San Hill]] doing so. Vader responded by closing the doors to the room and destroying the control panel with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], trapping the Separatists inside. Hill, realizing Vader was Skywalker, recoiled in horror as Vader activated his lightsaber and stabbed him through his three hearts, killing him.<ref name="RotSn" />

[[File:Mission-to-Mustafar.png|thumb|left|250px|Passel Argente being slain by Darth Vader.]]
With Hill dead, Vader then turned to two members of the Neimoidian Gunnery Battalion, [[Gap Nox/Legends|Gap Nox]] and [[Fame Drimal/Legends|Fame Drimal]], who were standing next to the door he had entered from and killed them.<ref name="The Devious Neimoidians">{{Facebook|username=star-wars-sourcebooks|url=notes/star-wars-sourcebooks/creating-naming-the-devious-neimoidians/676129629103814|name=Star Wars Sourcebooks|date=Jan 19, 2014|archivefile=File:NeimoidiansFacebook.pdf}}</ref> Engaging in a rampant killing spree, Vader strode around the room, slaughtering members of the council, their aides, and more members of the Neimoidian Gunnery Battalion, along with destroying the security battle droids. The war room had automated defense systems, but Vader was able to defend against them. As he first walked around, he killed the [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]] of the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]], [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]] and his aide [[Denaria Kee/Legends|Denaria Kee]]; [[Ando system/Legends|Ando system]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Po Nudo/Legends|Po Nudo]], and his aides, [[Nank Tun/Legends|Nank Tun]] and [[Unidentified Aqualish Aide|another Aqualish]]; [[Mon Calamari system/Legends|Mon Calamari system]] Senator [[Tikkes/Legends|Tikkes]]; [[Cat Miin/Legends|Cat Miin]], the aide of the [[Presidente/Legends|Presidente]] of the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]], [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]]; and several Trade Federation advisors, which included [[Aruteous Gunnay]] and [[Aito Laff]].<ref name="RotS" />

[[File:DisneyPlusStarWarsEpisodeIIIRevengeoftheSith_Promo_Background.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Vader during the assassination.]]

Vader then killed the [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]], who attempted to defend himself with his cane, and Mai, who pleaded with Vader, claiming that they were promised a handsome reward, to which he mockingly stated that ''he'' was their reward and questioned that she didn't find him handsome before slicing her head off.<ref name="RotSn" />

Gunray, his [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Rune Haako/Legends|Rune Haako]], and [[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]] of the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] fled into a nearby conference room. Vader followed, scraping his lightsaber along the wall. Haako tripped over a chair and Vader caught up to him, ignoring the Neimoidian's pleas, and slashed him across his body. Vader then found Tambor clawing at the conference room's viewports. Tambor offered to give Vader anything if he allowed him to live,<ref name="RotSn" /> but Vader grabbed his shoulder and thrust his lightsaber through his chest,<ref name="The Cinema Behind ''Star Wars''">{{SW|url=news/the-cinema-behind-star-wars-the-godfather|text=The Cinema Behind ''Star Wars'': ''The Godfather''|nolive=1}}</ref> mockingly thanking him afterwards.<ref name="RotSn" />

[[File:TheDeathofNuteGunray.png|thumb|left|200px|Vader killing Nute Gunray]]
Gunray, now the last surviving member of the Separatist Council, fled back into the war room, only for Vader to give chase and jump in front of him. Gunray tried to beg with Vader, claiming that the war was over and Sidious had promised them peace, to which Vader responded that his transmission was garbled and Sidious actually said they'd be left "in pieces," before slashing him across his chest, killing him.<ref name="RotSn" /> Unbeknownst to the Separatists, Sidious had kept the connection open and watched the entire slaughter.<ref name="RotSjrn">[[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith (junior novelization)|''Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith'' (junior novelization)]]</ref>

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|The Separatists have been taken care of, my master.''"<br />"''It is finished, then. You have restored peace and justice to the galaxy.|Darth Vader and Darth Sidious|<ref name="RotS" />}}
[[File:Conferenceroom.png|thumb|right|200px|Wat Tambor's body lying on the floor of the conference room.]]
Vader went outside the war room and stood on a balcony that overlooked the lava below and gazed out at the sky, a tear flowing down his cheek as he reflected on his transformation to a Sith Lord and subsequent evil deeds.<ref name="RotS" /> He then went back inside and looked out the viewports of the conference room, where he thought about the galaxy and his plans to rule it. Returning to the war room, he contacted Darth Sidious and informed him that the Separatists had been killed.<ref name="RotSn" /> Sidious then ordered Vader to send a message to the ships of the Trade Federation, which stated that all remaining droid units were to immediately shut down. Vader did so, effectively ending the Clone Wars. As he sent the shut down order, he noticed the [[J-type diplomatic barge|starship]] of his wife, [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] approaching the facility. When he went outside to greet Amidala and ask why she was there, Vader noticed Kenobi, his former master, standing on the [[Entry ramp/Legends|entry ramp]] of the ship, having stowed away onboard without Amidala's knowledge.<ref name="RotS" />

Vader, misled into believing that Amidala had brought Kenobi to kill him, [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force choked]] her and [[Duel on Mustafar/Legends|dueled Kenobi]], with their fight making their way through the war room, onto the balcony, and into the rest of the facility.<ref name="RotS" />

After the massacre of their leaders, the Trade Federation and the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] were forced to turn over their assets to the Empire, the former of which attempted a [[Five Veils Campaign|last stand]] against the Empire, while the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]] and the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] were quietly dissolved. The [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]], however, survived the catastrophe, though it was much less successful than before.<ref name="RHNSIE" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Conference.jpg|thumb|left|320px|Concept art by [[Ryan Church]]]]
This mission was first depicted in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], released in [[2005]].

In the DVD commentary of ''Revenge of the Sith'', [[George Lucas]] stated that the interwoven scenes of the Mission to Mustafar and the Declaration of a New Order was an homage to the christening and assassination sequence of the [[1972]] mob classic film [[Wikipedia:The Godfather|''The Godfather'']], directed by his friend [[Wikipedia:Francis Ford Coppola|Francis Ford Coppola]].<ref name="Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith">{{Film|III}} DVD commentary</ref>

In the [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith (video game)|''Revenge of the Sith'' video game]], Vader is depicted fighting his way through the mining facility after killing two aides at the landing platform and battling [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] and [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] guards. Upon reaching the war room, Vader kills Poggle the Lesser with the room's [[Blast door/Legends|blast door]] and kills Wat Tambor, two unidentified Neimoidians, and Rune Haako, who pleads for his life before dying. As Nute Gunray attempts to escape in his shuttle, Vader brings it down into the [[Magma/Legends|lava]] below.

The [[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]] depicts Vader as killing each of the Council members in a particularly brutal way and responding to the Separatists' pleas for mercy with amusing one liners and witty wordplay. In particular, he responded to Nute Gunray's pleas of Sidious's promise to leave them "in peace" with the remark, "His transmission was garbled. He promised to leave you in ''pieces''." Also notable is that this version marks San Hill as the first casualty, followed by Poggle, then Shu Mai, then Rune Haako, then Wat Tambor, then Nute Gunray.
